reason: I keep giving free meals to creators and I have no idea if anyone walks in because of them. If DM enquiries really land in my WhatsApp and get counted every Sunday with no coupons for my staff, the free month is worth trying, and ₹999 is nothing for a chain if the numbers show up.
objection: I already have a marketing person, so the posting part is just an overlap. A DM enquiry is not someone at the counter, and I'm not sure the Sunday count matches what I see in my UPI settlements. I'm also nervous about a small beta team handling the creator collabs under my brand.
would_change_my_mind: If after the free month the enquiry numbers don't line up with any change in my evening UPI settlements, I cancel. Proof from another Bengaluru outlet that a Mitra creator campaign brought paying customers would get me on the ₹2,499 plan.
